description:
A multi-platform launcher for your anime games

Twintaillauncher is a multi-platform launcher that brings mod support, quality-of-life improvements, and advanced features to a variety of anime-styled games.
Games
- Added original Arknights
- Added Stella Sora
Localization
- Added polish translation
Linux
- Added new proton runner Proton CachyOS wineland (https://github.com/nanomatters/proton-cachyos for more information)
Bug fixes & Improvements
- Fixed a regression that caused xxmi to download in broken state
- Steam imported installations can not trigger predownload anymore as they are managed by Steam
- Steam shortcuts are now not possible to be made if both Steam and TwintailLauncher are flatpak applications due to sandbox limitations
- Fix AUR annoying you to constantly update twintaillauncher-git due to wrong commit grab in automated tooling
KNOWN ISSUES
- Gamescope under flatpak is broken and works as intended until 3.0.0 (its flatpak yea... it will be fun)
- Arknights and Stella Sora DO NOT provide normal update paths until 3.0.0 app will redownload on update
NOTE: There will be extra flatpak update to address steamdeck gaming mode regression stay tuned until flathub team approves the changes needed
What's Changed
- Fix runner blacklist check for full paths (correct branch) by @MVDW-Java in #298
- Add Polish translation by @SIRVER21 in #306
- Release 2.5.0 by @TukanDev in #312
New Contributors
- @MVDW-Java made their first contribution in #298
- @SIRVER21 made their first contribution in #306
Full Changelog: ttl-v2.4.0...ttl-v2.5.0
